cc:Work.dc:title: maxwell-time convergence
cc:Work.dc:description: maxwell-time; all 4 measured levels; fixed final-four diagnostic window. Fixed constrained spatial Maxwell operator; staggered electric/magnetic field times. All four time steps; fixed two-dimensional P3/P1 Maxwell constrained operator; comparison at each respective electric/magnetic time. Physical L2 norms of differences to scipy.linalg.expm of the same semidiscrete ODE; no classical spatial comparator claimed. Record examples/results/tutorial-methods/maxwell-time-current.json; SHA256 0b0997fba54eff2c704f8c81e4bab17da48e31a78f9bf3cbc86637d13cb9869a. Second-order leapfrog time integration against the exact constrained semidiscrete evolution. CC BY 4.0 — IPES Research Group; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
